correctness.rationale: Critical exponential integrability gives a real-analytic Hilbert functional, whose uniformly negative stable Hessian admits a coercive analytic Lyapunov–Schmidt reduction. The all-m fourth/sixth Fourier coefficients fix the sharp normal form; the exact phase-orbit distance supplies the lower coefficient and a four-mode construction attains it. A self-contained exact checker passed 24 coefficient tests, which supplement rather than prove the infinite-dimensional argument.
